best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron from the ventral neuroblast (ALv1) lineage whose dendrites mainly innervate antennal lobe glomerulus DA1 (Jefferis et al., 2007; Bates et al., 2020). It projects via the mediolateral antennal lobe tract to reach the lateral horn directly (Jefferis et al., 2007). This neuron is GABAergic and there is around one per hemisphere ((Jefferis et al., 2007; Bates et al., 2020).
